text: わるい　こと　やりまくると　スカッと　するぜ！

structure.jp: わるい　こと　やりまくると
structure.en: when you do bad things like crazy

patterns.name: 〜まくる
patterns.explanation: まくる added to a verb means doing it over and over without holding back. やりまくる = 'do like crazy'.

patterns.name: 〜と (condition)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever you do this, that follows'. やりまくると = 'when you do it like crazy'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, cocky male speech. スカッと　するぜ = 'it feels great, man'.
